name: polyp-facetank
description: ACCEPTANCE, cost: park a bot inside the lane the Iris Polyp locks (?polyp=1 solo stage) and measure what standing in the beam costs. Movement is policy-only so the run self-corrects whichever band the early hops landed it in: hold right only while x<59.5, funnel down off post-high (down+jump drop-through) or up off the deck (jump onto the one-way catwalk) until the bot stands on post-mid inside the beam band, then stay. Expected rhythm: tell -> fire costs exactly one point per iris cycle (i-frames outlast one volley, expire well inside the cycle), the beam's knockback shoves the bot out and the x-gate walks it back in. Reported as a damage count over ~2 cycles, not a pass/fail on completion — eating the beam is allowed to be a choice, it just has to cost. KNOWN LIMIT (harness, not enemy): the open-loop approach hops fork on dispatch quantization and can jam a run in the chimney or dare pocket (~1 in 7 observed); the run then stalls at x<57 with the polyp never engaged — re-run it.
